hero.title: Supplier Partnership Programme — Integrated Supply Chain, Guaranteed Demand
hero.subtitle: Distribute certified inputs — seeds, fertilizers and packaging — through the Bio Vera grower network in your region. Guaranteed demand, fixed pricing structure and integrated logistics.

whoApply.title: Who Should Apply
whoApply.intro: Established companies in the agri sector — distributors, agricultural retailers or operators with warehouse infrastructure and an existing network in the region. We seek partners who can provide field-level support and distribution under Bio Vera standards.

yourRole.title: Your Role
yourRole.intro: Regional operations partner within the Bio Vera network. You manage distribution of certified inputs, provide field-level support to growers and uphold quality standards locally. Coordination with the central team through the Vera Admin Panel.

cards.title: Guaranteed Offtake
cards.description: Our growers source from approved suppliers. Stable demand and predictable revenue.

cards.title: Price Stability
cards.description: Pre-agreed pricing structure. No fluctuations or per-transaction negotiations.

cards.title: Integrated Logistics
cards.description: Inputs are distributed through Bio Vera's integrated logistics network — refrigerated return haulage. No additional logistics costs for the partner.

cards.title: National Coverage
cards.description: Expand your reach and represent Bio Vera across your country.

cards.title: Exclusive Market Access
cards.description: Access to Bio Vera's network of certified growers and European buyers through vertically integrated infrastructure.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Suppliers procure from our approved partners, distribute to certified growers at pre-agreed prices. Every transaction tracked through QR codes. Inventory movements recorded in real time with automatic alerts at 20% threshold.

requirements.title: Programme Requirements
requirements.subtitle: Dry, secure storage for Vera seeds, fertilizers and packaging. QR scanning mandatory for every dispatch. Physical verification of received goods. Digital-only record keeping through the Vera Admin Dashboard.

application.title: Supplier Application
application.intro: Apply online. You receive a reference code to track your application. Our team contacts you to schedule a meeting; upon approval we create your partner store account.
application.receivedBody: We will contact you to schedule a conversation. Save your reference number — you can use it to check your application status anytime.
